LESSON: ORAL HYGIENE PRACTICES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health
Topic 1.2: Oral hygiene practices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Oral hygiene practices. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Oral hygiene practices
2. Give Kenyan examples for Oral hygiene practices
3. Practise Oral hygiene practices at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ORAL HYGIENE PRACTICES
This lesson teaches Oral hygiene practices for Grade 3 HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Oral hygiene practices
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Oral hygiene practices
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Oral hygiene practices at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Oral hygiene practices using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Oral hygiene practices above.
2. Explain Oral hygiene practices to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Oral hygiene practices.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Oral hygiene practices with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Oral hygiene practices important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Oral hygiene practices
2. Give Kenyan examples for Oral hygiene practices
3. Practise Oral hygiene practices at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
